text:
maria-partnerships: Heads up — AWS PO #PO-9584 is stuck in procurement. They flagged that the signer on the PO doesn't match the billing entity on the contract. Procurement won't approve until signatory matches or we accept a signed addendum. @sarah-legal could you confirm options?

sarah-legal: On it. Do we have the customer's legal signatory name? The PO shows 'Acme Cloud Inc' but our contract is under 'Acme Holdings Ltd'.

jonathan-sales: Customer insists billing entity must match issuing entity. They previously routed signing through the holding co. They're refusing to reissue a PO until we accept the holding company as payor.

alex-finance: We need matching tax ID on the PO. Treasury flagged mismatch — need new PO or an addendum. Can Treasury accept an alias/letter of authority?

sarah-legal: We can accept an addendum if they provide an org chart + signed letter of authorization. I'll draft a short amendment template. ETA ~2h.

maria-partnerships: :eyes: Customer is pushing for go-live by EOD Friday. If we wait on an addendum, timeline slips.

nate-ops: If payment entity differs from contract entity, we can still provision capacity but no data onboarding until legal clears. Risk surface increases though.

jonathan-sales: I'll ask the customer to fast-track a PO reissue. @po-bot can you pull the PO PDF?

po-bot: Attached PO (PO-9584.pdf) — shows issuing entity: Acme Cloud Inc. Metadata: amount $120,000, created 1848999900.

sarah-legal: Draft amendment ready — snippet below:
```
ADDENDUM: Acceptance of Third-Party Billing Entity
Customer: [Customer Name]
Billing Entity: [Billing Entity] (Tax ID: [Tax ID])
Authorized Signatory: [Name], [Title]
Effective as of: [Date]
```
Replace placeholders and get signed on company letterhead.

alex-finance: If they provide signed letter + tax ID, treasury can make a one-off acceptance pending CFO sign-off. We'll need scanned docs emailed to treasury@redwood.com.

jonathan-sales: On call with Erin (erin@acme.com) — finance can sign the letter in ~30m. Asking if the addendum form is acceptable to legal & finance.

maria-partnerships: We can provisionally reserve 2 nodes under a 'soft hold' tag but no data ingestion until procurement confirms. @nate-ops ok?

nate-ops: OK. We'll flag capacity as hold:acme-9584. No data onboarding until procurement sign-off.

sarah-legal: Sending amendment template to Erin. Standard requirements: signed on letterhead, tax ID, signatory name/title. Notarization optional.

jonathan-sales: Will escalate to Erin now and update thread.

maria-partnerships: :thumbsup: Keep updates here. If they push back, escalate to VP sales.

jonathan-sales: Update ~20m — Erin says finance will sign and send scanned letter today. They're asking if addendum is sufficient.

sarah-legal: Addendum + signed letter is sufficient. Once we receive it, legal will issue an acceptance email and instruct treasury to process the PO.

alex-finance: Once we get documents, I'll queue PO approval. Processing ETA 24–48h depending on CFO review.

maria-partnerships: Marking thread status: in-flight — awaiting signed addendum & tax ID. I'll coordinate timeline if anything changes.
